rules: challenge cases generated or selected outside ORBYTHRA custody
validator nonce kept outside system until submission
validator signs exact evaluation payload with registered Ed25519 key
challenge IDs unique and case IDs unique
no benchmark answers embedded in repository
result report includes release SHA, case-set digest, validator key fingerprint and statistical metrics
boundary: Protocol controls reduce benchmark leakage risk but do not prove independent custody unless an external validator follows and attests to them.
